verdict.rationale: Gram supports bringing your own OAuth 2.0 provider (Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, or a custom server) so the underlying credentials are fully controlled by the platform-engineer, and RBAC/OAuth2.1 syncs to enterprise IDPs. However, there is no documented evidence of UI-level 'white-labeling' — custom branding/logo/domain on the consent or login screen itself — only backend provider configuration. Missing for 10: evidence of custom branding/theming of the OAuth consent screen or hosted login page, and confirmation that the authorization UI itself (not just the provider) can be rebranded.
